title: NetrunnerEngineCard
description: Card definition as pure data. Effect IR is the executable language; unknown IR nodes fail closed at load time.

addPowerCounterOnSubroutineResolve.description: Place this many power counters on the run source whenever a subroutine resolves during the run (Raindrops Cut Stone).

onRunEnd.description: Effect IR fired when the run ends (success or not), sourced on the run event/ability card.

skipBreach.description: On successful run, skip breaching the attacked server (e.g. Chastushka replace-breach).

blankAttackedServerRoot.description: During this run, cards in the root of the attacked server lose all abilities (Light the Fire!).

advancementRequirementEqualsRunnerGrip.description: When true, advancement requirement equals the number of cards in the Runner grip (Blood in the Water).

advancementRequirementReductionPerTag.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per Runner tag (Freedom of Information).

advancementRequirementReductionPerCoreDa.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per core damage the Runner has taken this game (Ontological Dependence).

advancementRequirementReductionPerBadPub.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by per × Corp bad publicity, counting at most max BP (Regulatory Capture).

breaksSubtype.description: Ice subtype to break, or "*" for AI.

breakViaPaidAbilityOnly.description: When true, standard credit break is disabled; breaks only via paidAbilities (e.g. Revolver).

breakMaxSubs.description: Max subroutines per paid break ability use (default 1).

breakCreditsDiscountPerInstalledSubtype.description: Reduce breakCredits by amount × count of installed cards with subtype (Tremolo: cybernetic).

breakRequiresAttackingMark.description: Standard credit break only while attacking the mark (Tunnel Vision).

advancementTokens.description: Spend hosted advancement tokens from this card as a cost (Drago Ivanov).

coreDamage.description: Suffer this much core damage as a cost (Light the Fire!).

oncePerEncounter.description: Enforce once-per-encounter usage (Slap Vandal break host).

usableFromHq.description: Corp paid ability usable while this card is in HQ (Expendable; Tree Line).

requireEncounterSubtype.description: Encountered ice must have this subtype (e.g. Abagnale bypass).

requireAttackingMark.description: Ability usable only while attacking the designated mark (e.g. Backstitching).

hostStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify host ice strength by this amount (Monkeywrench).

otherIceProtectingServerStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify strength of each other ice protecting the same server (Monkeywrench).

onBypass.description: Effect IR when the Runner bypasses a piece of ice (Capybara).

onScore.description: Effect IR evaluated when Corp scores this agenda.

scoreAdditionalCost.description: Additional cost Effect IR paid before scoring this agenda (e.g. Azef Protocol must trash 1 other installed Corp card).

onSteal.description: Effect IR evaluated when Runner steals this agenda.

onEncounter.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner encounters this ice.

onPass.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner passes this ice (Phoneutria).

threatCannotSpendCreditsDuringSubs.description: Threat N → Runner cannot spend credits while subroutines on this ice are resolving (Attini).

onApproachServer.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner approaches the server this card protects (rezzed upgrade/asset in root; e.g. Nanisivik Grid).

remoteOnly.description: Corp may only install this card in a remote server (e.g. ZATO City Grid).

iceGainsTrashToResolveChosenSubOnEncount.description: While rezzed: each ice protecting this server gains encounter ability — choose 1 subroutine; may trash the ice to resolve it (ZATO City Grid).

firstEncounterSubsBecomeNetDamage.description: While installed: during the first encounter each turn with ice protecting the server named via may_choose_server / namedServerId, each subroutine resolves as Do N net damage instead (Tsakhia Bankhar Gantulga).

trashWhenNoHostedCards.description: When this card has no hosted cards remaining, trash it (Asmund Pudlat).

onTurnBegin.description: Effect IR evaluated when this card's controller's turn begins (rezzed/installed).

onInstall.description: Effect IR evaluated when this card is installed.

onSuccessfulRun.description: Effect IR when the Runner makes a successful run while this card is installed (or is the Runner identity).

onSuccessfulRunOncePerTurn.description: When true, onSuccessfulRun fires at most once per turn for this instance (e.g. first successful run on the mark).

onAccess.description: Effect IR when this card is accessed (ambushes).

mustRevealWhenAccessedFromRd.description: Static ability: while accessing this card in R&D, the Runner must reveal it (CR §1.21.7).

skipOnAccessFromArchives.description: When true, onAccess does not fire if this card is accessed from Archives (Snare!, Behold!).

onFirstTagThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner is tagged each turn (identities).

onFirstCoreDamageThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner suffers core damage each turn (Runner identities; CR §10.4.2b).

onFirstRdRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner begins a run on R&D each turn (Runner identities; e.g. Padma may charge).

onFirstVirusInstallThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner installs a virus program each turn (installed continuous; e.g. Avgustina sabotage).

onFirstSuccessfulMarkRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on their mark (installed continuous / identity; e.g. Virtuoso HQ bonus access or post-run HQ breach).

onFirstSuccessfulHqRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on HQ (installed continuous; e.g. PAN-Weave Corp loses 1¢ / Runner gains 1¢ if they do).

onFirstSuccessfulCentralRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on a central server (HQ / R&D / Archives; installed continuous; e.g. Zenit Chip draw 1).

onFirstSuccessfulRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on any server (e.g. Pravdivost may place 1 advancement).

onProgramOrHardwareInstall.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs a program or piece of hardware (installed continuous; e.g. Environmental Testing place 1 power counter).

amount.description: Fire when hosted power counters reach this many or more.

effect.description: Effect IR evaluated when the threshold is met (e.g. trash self + gain credits).

onPowerCountersGte.description: Static-condition ability when hosted power counters ≥ amount (e.g. Environmental Testing trash + gain 9¢).

onAgendaScored.description: Effect IR when Corp scores any agenda (identity or installed continuous).

onAgendaScoredOrStolen.description: Effect IR when any agenda is scored or stolen (installed continuous, e.g. Daeg).

onAgendaStolen.description: Effect IR when the Runner steals an agenda (Corp identity, e.g. Thule Subsea).

onFullyBreakOncePerTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice (Orca, Abaasy).

gainCreditsOnFirstMarkRunEndIfBreached.description: Gain this many credits the first time each turn a run on your mark ends if you breached (Info Bounty).

meatDamageOnInstalledCorpTrashOncePerTur.description: Do this much meat damage the first time each turn the Runner trashes an installed Corp card (Hostile Architecture).

maySpendPowerCountersForBonusRdAccess.description: When breaching R&D, may remove up to max hosted power counters for that many bonus accesses (Wake Implant).

powerOnScoreIfAgendaNotInstalledOrAdvanc.description: When scoring an agenda not installed or advanced this turn, place 1 power counter (Issuaq Adaptics).

agendaPointsToWinReductionPerPowerCounte.description: Reduce agenda points needed to win by this amount per hosted power counter (Issuaq Adaptics).

creditsOnTrashFromThisServer.description: Gain this many credits when a card is trashed from this server's root or ice, except during install (Yakov).

blanksHostAbilities.description: While hosted on ice, host loses abilities except printed subroutines (Hush).

chargeOnFirstBreakDuringHostEncounter.description: First break during an encounter with host ice: may charge (Flux Capacitor).

hostedCreditsOnInstall.description: Credits placed on this card when installed (e.g. Armitage).

strengthBonusProtectingRemote.description: Printed strength bonus while protecting a remote server.

strengthBonusProtectingArchives.description: Printed strength bonus while protecting Archives (Bathynomus).

handSizeBonus.description: Modifier to controller max hand size while installed/scored.

allottedClicksBonus.description: Modifier to allotted clicks each of the controller's turns while installed (Basilar Synthgland).

excludeSubtype.description: Do not grant the bonus to icebreakers with this subtype (K2CP Turbine: ai).

giveStrengthToInstalledIcebreakers.description: Aura: each other installed icebreaker gets +amount strength (K2CP Turbine).

rfgOnUninstall.description: When this card is uninstalled from the rig, remove it from the game instead of trashing to heap (Nanuq).

memoryCost.description: Memory units used by this program (default 1).

muBonus.description: Bonus to Runner memory limit while installed.

strengthBonusPerCoreDamageThisGame.description: Strength bonus per core damage the Runner has taken this game (Begemot).

threatStrengthBonus.description: Threat N → adjust this card's strength by amount while threat is active (Shibboleth).

playRequiresMinTags.description: Play only if the Runner has at least this many tags (Shipment from Vladisibirsk).

rezAdditionalCostDerezSubtype.description: As an additional rez cost, derez another rezzed ice with this subtype (Bloop / harmonic).

handSizePerPowerCounter.description: Runner max hand size +N per hosted power counter (Hippocampic Mechanocytes).

runnerHandSizePenaltyPerPowerCounter.description: While rezzed: Runner max hand size −N per hosted power counter (Dr. Vientiane Keeling).

installRequiresSuccessfulCentralRunThisT.description: Install only if Runner made a successful run on a central this turn (Time Bomb).

coreDamageOnAgendaScoredFromThisServer.description: When Corp scores an agenda from this server's root, do this much core damage (Djupstad Grid).

playRequiresAgendaStolenThisTurn.description: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda this turn (Reprise).

runEventOptional.description: When true with runEvent, playing without a server skips the run (Reprise may-run).

playRequiresAgendaStolenLastTurn.description: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn (Distributed Tracing).

unsupported.description: Explicit notes for clauses not implemented in the engine/IR yet.

nrdbCode.description: Optional NetrunnerDB code — metadata only, not behavior.

iceRezCostIncreaseBySubtype.description: While installed, increase rez cost of ice with this subtype by amount credits (CR §1.16.2a / §8.1.2d; e.g. Cat's Cradle code-gate-only).

rezCostDiscountPerRezzedSubtype.description: When rezzing this ice, reduce rez cost by amount per already-rezzed ice with this subtype (CR §1.16.2a / §8.1.2d; e.g. Ivik −1¢ per rezzed code gate).

eventPlayCostDiscount.description: While installed, lower the play cost of each event by this many credits (CR §1.16.2a; e.g. Ghosttongue).

badPublicityCountersOnRez.description: Load this many hosted bad publicity counters when this card is rezzed (Superdeep Borehole). Hosted BP is not player BP until taken.

winWhenBadPublicityCountersEmpty.description: While rezzed, when hosted bad publicity counters reach 0 the Corp wins (Superdeep Borehole).

playRequiresSuccessfulHqRunThisTurn.description: Play only if the Runner made a successful run on HQ this turn (e.g. Emergency Shutdown).

playRequiresSuccessfulAllCentralsThisTur.description: Play only if successful runs on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn (Deep Dive).

playAdditionalClicks.description: Extra clicks beyond the first when playing (triples = 2). Overrides playAdditionalClick count.

etrSubroutinesPerPowerCounter.description: Ice gains an ETR subroutine before printed ones per hosted power counter (Envelopment).

powerCounterOnHarmonicIceRez.description: When any harmonic ice is rezzed, place 1 power counter on this ice (Echo).

powerOnFirstInstalledCardCreditSpendThis.description: First spend of credits from an installed card each turn places 1 power (The Twinning).

removePowerForBonusAccessOnHqRdBreach.description: On HQ/R&D breach, remove up to this many power for bonus accesses (The Twinning).

onTrash.description: Effect IR when this Corp card is trashed to Archives (Mavirus).

onTrashFromGripOrStack.description: Effect IR when this Runner card is trashed from grip or stack (Steelskin).

onRezzedCardTrashed.description: Identity: when a rezzed Corp card is trashed not during install (Ob Superheavy).

endsActionPhase.description: Terminal: end the action phase after resolving this operation (Big Deal).

playAdditionalCost.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when playing this event/operation (e.g. Running Hot suffer core damage).
